ops.title: gt ship of a mid-stack branch now resubmits published children (PR #283)
ops.body: ccx v0.72.30: ship --amend (or a new commit) on a mid-stack gt branch restacked children locally (gtModifyRestack) but the isolated restack and shipPushGT only covered the downstack, so children stayed published on the replaced commit. Fix: gtPublishedUpstack (receipt-bearing children contiguous from the shipped branch) joins the stack-rebase members and the submit; report adds 'resubmitted <branches> above <branch>'. --tip-only unchanged. Test: TestShipAmendOfAMidStackBranchCarriesItsChildren. Local testing note: run internal/cli tests with PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/git/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin; a shell inheriting the monorepo's mise shims (jj, gt) and hook shims fails ~700 fixture tests spuriously.
